# ROCK Water

> ROCK is natural spring water from the Smoky Mountains with three electrolytes (sodium citrate, potassium carbonate, magnesium sulfate), natural pH 7.8 or higher, 0 sugar and 0 calories, in a 12oz infinitely recyclable aluminum can. Based in Scottsdale, Arizona, founded by Brett Yanofsky. 1% of sales go to environmental causes through 1% for the Planet.

Serves Maricopa County, Arizona: Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria and nearby.

- [Shop ROCK](https://www.drinkrockwater.com/shop.html): 12-pack $34, subscribe and save 30%.
